title: Zephyr: DIO encode/decode
notes: Implemented strict atomic Zephyr DIO codec behavior in rpl_messages: complete option-chain framing validation; strict singleton DODAG Configuration and SCHC Rule Version validation; reserved G/MOP bit, base flags, reserved octet, and local RPLInstanceID rejection; decode-to-temporary semantics; semantic field checks; and new atomic base+options encoder with alias-safe input and exact capacity checks. Added canonical shared-vector encode/decode coverage plus direct malformed/truncated/duplicate-config/reserved/rank-boundary/alias/unchanged-output regressions. Gates: host rpl_messages CTest 1/1 passed; Python DIO suite 62/62 and vector generator parity 1/1 passed; Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 messages.c scoped object compiled with SDK 0.16.8. Local pinned v3.7 tree is absent as documented; full 4.1 image remains blocked by unrelated HAL/nrfx/Monocypher warnings before RPL link.
close_reason: Complete: strict atomic DIO base/options codec and shared-vector regression gates pass
